hzd-plugin.plugin.name: HZD Administration
hzd-plugin.homepage.title: HZD Administration
hzd-plugin.homepage.description: Tools and reports for HZD administration processes.
hzd-plugin.reports.users.title: User Report
hzd-plugin.reports.users.description: Checks breeder owner members for missing publishMyData.
hzd-plugin.reports.users.error: The user report could not be generated.
hzd-plugin.reports.breeders.title: Breeder Report
hzd-plugin.reports.breeders.description: Checks active, non-disabled breeders for missing owner members.

hzd-plugin.litterReminder.title: Litter reminder
hzd-plugin.litterReminder.description: Sends an email to the breeder of every litter in status Littered whose date of birth is more than the selected number of weeks ago.
hzd-plugin.litterReminder.error: The litter reminders could not be sent.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.title: Chromosoft
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.description: Imports the CS_Member and CS_Dog rows of the current import generation.

hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.error: The Chromosoft data could not be imported.
